mechanism: Amphetamine increases sympathomimetic activity and cardiovascular stress while semaglutide increases heart rate and blood pressure; combined use elevates risk of tachycardia, hypertension, and cardiac arrhythmias, particularly concerning in patients with pre-existing cardiovascular disease.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use lowest effective doses with close cardiac monitoring including ECG and blood pressure surveillance, and consider alternative appetite suppressants or ADHD medications with lower sympathomimetic activity.
